name: Portrait of Priest Dazhi (1048–1116), Master of Law
material: Hanging scroll; ink and light color on silk
summary: Monk Yuanzhao, with the honorific title Dazhi Lüshi, Great Wisdom Master of Vinaya, is depicted here as an itinerant monk, holding his alms bowl in the left and staff in the right.
